in_hindi.name: क़ुतैबा

in_english.name: Qutaiba
in_english.meaning: A masculine name meaning group, community, or assembly
in_english.long_meaning: Qutaiba is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the root 'q-t-b' which means 'group', 'community', or 'assembly'. The name signifies the importance of social bonds and collective responsibility. Although not directly mentioned in the Quran, the root 'q-t-b' has been used in various Islamic texts to denote unity and congregation. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the value of community and social ties.
